cards.mood: The piece opens with a claustrophobic and tense atmosphere, characterized by restrained instrumentation that mirrors internal struggle.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars provide the core harmonic weight, playing chugging, palm-muted riffs in the verses and opening up into soaring, sustained power chords during the choruses.

[Intro]
[Verse]
Walls are closing like a heavy fist
Shadows dancing in the rising mist
Stone is cracking underneath the weight
